item.description: The latest Teams meeting experiences will be available for Teams on the web in Safari and Firefox browsers - including performance improvements, refreshed pre-join, updated meeting stage, and the updated meeting toolbar. (for anonymous join only)

item.title: RM380852: Microsoft Teams: Change background while recording on phone
item.description: You can record a video clip with your phone camera and switch your background to any picture you want or make it blurry. With this feature, you can record yourself anywhere and share it with coworkers in your Teams chat or channel.

item.description: This feature allows users to subscribe to notifications for Viva Engage topics they follow. Users will receive a Viva Engage bell notification when a new post is tagged with a topic they are subscribed to or when the topic is added to an existing post.

item.title: RM398447: Microsoft Teams: School Connection – Providing access to parents via their phone number
item.description: The School Connection app in Microsoft Teams (mobile) empowers parents and guardians to engage, support, and monitor their student's learning at school. This release enables a parent/guardian to get access to their child’s profile in School Connection if they login to Teams (mobile) with their phone number and the school has registered that phone number as a parent/guardian contact. item.title: RM402185: Microsoft Teams: EDU tenant type selection in policy wizard
item.description: Admins can now select tenant type for their institution from the policy wizard. This setting can be changed anytime from the wizard.

item.title: MC1532259: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of Translate slides in PowerPoint Live
item.description: Starting November 30, 2026, the Translate slides feature in PowerPoint Live during Microsoft Teams meetings will be retired worldwide. Attendees will no longer translate slides; slides will display in their original language. No admin action is needed, but organizations should notify users and update related training materials.

item.title: RM382643: Microsoft Viva: Search in Viva Connections on iOS and Android tablet
item.description: This adds a search entry point and a new tailored experience for Viva Connection users on iOS and Android tablets.

item.title: RM420335: Microsoft Edge: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge is being upgraded to include enterprise data protection compliance standards
item.description: Writing Assistance with Copilot in Edge, which lets users edit typed text for tone, format, and length within an open page in Microsoft Edge, is being updated to include enterprise data protection for commercial customers. Once Writing Assistance is available, users signed in with a Microsoft Entra ID will have enterprise data protection when using the feature in Microsoft Edge.

item.title: RM464990: Microsoft 365: Create full-workload backup policies for Microsoft 365 Backup
item.description: Automatically backup all Exchange or OneDrive users and/or SharePoint sites in the tenant and have the tool automatically add new users/sites to the backup policy.

item.title: RM565370: Microsoft Teams: Emoji shortcuts with autocomplete on mobile
item.description: Teams brings desktop-style emoji shortcuts to mobile (iOS and Android), allowing you to insert emojis by typing colon-based commands like :smile:. Real-time autocomplete suggestions help you quickly find the right emoji as you type, while support for custom emojis enables more personalized and expressive communication on the go.

item.title: RM566523: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator follow-up mode
item.description: Chat naturally with Facilitator without tagging it each time.

item.title: RM568073: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns in SharePoint
item.description: Campaigns in SharePoint (site campaigns) is a new capability that brings Viva Amplify’ s campaign management natively into SharePoint. Corporate communications teams now have a unified place to create, distribute, and measure their news without leaving the platform where their news content already lives. item.title: RM568075: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention - Data Security for non-Microsoft connected apps
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention and Information Protection Auto-labeling capabilities now extend to non-Microsoft connected apps (e.g., Google Workspace, Box, Dropbox, Salesforce, ServiceNow, Amazon Web Services, and Cisco Webex). The conditions and actions supported for each of these applications vary.

item.title: RM570157: Microsoft Viva: Campaigns Hub in Engage and Engage in Teams mobile
item.description: The Campaigns Hub in Viva Engage provides a centralized mobile destination where employees can discover and participate in organizational campaigns. Available in the Viva Engage app and Viva Engage in Teams mobile, the hub highlights top and sponsored campaigns, enables users to browse active and completed campaigns, and makes it easy to view campaign details and follow the campaigns that matter to them.

item.title: RM571387: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
item.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

item.title: RM573451: Microsoft Teams: Third-party synthetic audio and video detection in Microsoft Teams
item.description: Organizations can enhance meeting security with synthetic audio and video detection solutions provided by certified third-party providers. Third-party detection solutions analyze meeting media for signs of synthetic or manipulated audio and video and send detection signals to Teams, enabling integrated in-meeting experiences and controls. Important: Synthetic media detection is performed by the third-party provider. Microsoft Teams provides the platform integration and experiences for surfacing...

item.title: RM573452: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
item.description: Help people get started faster by automatically connecting new team members to relevant channels when they join a team. Improve engagement, accelerate onboarding, and make it easier to discover important information from day one.

item.title: RM573706: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
item.description: Event group chat, the private chat for organizers, co-organizers, and presenters in an event or structured meeting, will support external presenters.

item.title: RM576710: Microsoft Purview: Introducing IRM Alert classification
item.description: Insider risk management will be introducing the ability to classify alerts as True positive, Benign (operational), and False positive. This will be available on all alerts where authorized analysts with the appropriate permissions can choose from a list of predefined classification reasons. Alert classification will help tenants to better classify risk within alerts to support reporting and tuning needs. This will replace existing dismissal reasons.

item.title: RM576711: Microsoft Teams: AI Interpreter for Teams Events
item.description: AI Interpreter for Events brings real-time, AI-powered audio interpretation to Teams Town Halls and Webinars, helping global audiences follow events in their preferred language. Organizers can configure supported languages for their event, giving attendees a more natural and engaging multilingual experience beyond translated captions.

item.title: RM576745: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Streamline Quick Campaigns for confident, one-time bulk email outreach
item.description: Quick Campaigns support multiple bulk activity types (email, tasks, appointments, phone calls). This release focuses on improving the end-to-end experience for bulk email creation, with foundational improvements that benefit the overall Quick Campaigns flow.

item.title: RM576806: Dynamics 365 Sales: Seller experiences - Copy opportunities for repeat deals
item.description: Administrators can control whether the Copy Opportunity feature is available. When enabled, sellers can duplicate an existing opportunity to quickly create a new one.

item.title: RM577172: Microsoft 365: [Education] Assign Study and Learn in Teams and LMS Assignments
item.description: Educators can assign Study and Learn from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open guided learning support grounded in the assignment's title, instructions, and supported files and resources, helping them work through concepts and practice their understanding.

item.title: RM577173: Microsoft 365: [Education] Provide a Copilot starter prompt in Teams and LMS Assignments
item.description: Educators can provide a Copilot starter prompt from Student AI Guidelines in Teams and LMS Assignments. Students open Copilot with the educator's prompt ready in their chat, helping them begin with instructions tailored to the assignment.

item.title: RM577174: Microsoft Teams: Workflow to automatically add tag members to relevant channels
item.description: Associate channels with a tag so members are automatically added to those channels when they join the tag. This helps teams keep channel membership in sync with evolving groups, reduces manual management, and ensures members have access to the conversations and content most relevant to their role.

item.title: RM577399: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced Copilot and AI controls for meetings
item.description: Teams Meetings offer enhanced AI controls for Copilot and AI experiences. Organizers manage who can enable and access AI, while IT admins get a simpler policy model for governing AI across meetings and post-meeting experiences. These updates provide more predictable administration and greater flexibility for compliance and governance scenarios.

item.title: RM579889: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Workspaces updates
item.description: With new Copilot Workspaces updates, Work IQ can suggest relevant workspaces based on current workstreams to help people get started quickly. Once in a workspace, team members can work together on shared documents while Copilot connects the dots across the work, surfacing what changed, what remains unresolved, and which actions need attention so everyone can quickly catch up and keep the work moving.

item.title: RM575277: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: D365 Contact Center Admin Center users can create CCI agents
item.description: Use the customer conversation harness agent builder to create, test, and refine AI-powered customer service agents. Accelerate agent development with built-in tools for conversation design, orchestration, evaluation, and deployment across customer engagement channels.

item.title: RM577885: Dynamics 365 Contact Center: Bullseye routing with dynamic user groups and skill relaxation
item.description: Bullseye routing now supports dynamic user groups and skill relaxation. Administrators can define dynamic groups using representatives’ skills and proficiency levels, and use them at different expansion levels. If work remains unassigned, required skills can be progressively relaxed to broaden the eligible representative pool and improve assignment opportunities—without manually maintaining group membership.

item.title: RM579864: Microsoft Teams: Focus on the conversation while Facilitator in Teams mobile takes the notes, now with speaker attribution
item.description: Use Facilitator in Teams mobile to turn in-person conversations into useful notes and follow-ups with speaker attribution. Start note-taking from your phone and let Facilitator capture and transcribe the ad hoc discussion, with speaker attribution helping distinguish who said what. Facilitator uses the conversation to generate notes, summaries, and follow-up actions, giving you a richer record of the discussion while letting you stay more present in the moment.

item.title: RM581739: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Sensitivity label inheritance for Teams meeting artifacts
item.description: Teams meeting artifacts, including recordings, transcripts, and Loop notes, can now be configured to automatically inherit the sensitivity label from the meeting. This ensures content generated during meetings is consistently protected without requiring manual labeling, reducing risk and simplifying protection at scale.

item.title: MC1518033: Microsoft Teams: Onboarding workflow for new team members
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce an onboarding workflow to automatically connect new members to relevant channels, improving engagement and onboarding speed. Rollout starts November 2026 (targeted) and general availability in March 2027. No admin action is needed, but team owners should be informed.

item.title: MC1540351: Microsoft Teams: Automatically add tag members to channels with Workflows
item.description: Microsoft Teams will introduce a Workflows app template to automatically add users to standard or shared channels when added to a team tag. Rollout starts November 2026 (Targeted Release) and completes by March 2027 (General Availability). The feature is optional and requires team owner configuration.

item.title: MC796790: Unified management of app and agent availability and installation in Teams, Outlook, and the Microsoft 365 app
item.description: Microsoft has unified app and agent availability and installation management across Teams, Outlook, and Microsoft 365 admin centers. Starting September 2025, availability unification occurs in phases, with installation unification generally available since November 2026, synchronizing settings within 24–48 hours after availability unification.

item.title: MC1559642: Continuous interpreter visibility with pop out video in Teams
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to pop out sign language interpreters' videos into a resizable, movable window to keep interpreters visible while multitasking. Rolling out December 2026–January 2027 on Windows and Mac. Users enable this via Accessibility settings; no admin action needed.

item.title: MC1559641: New Copilot experience in OneNote
item.description: The new Copilot experience in OneNote enhances editing and reasoning across notes, ink, annotations, and files, enabling better information synthesis and content creation. Rollout starts November 2026 for Frontier Public and January 2027 worldwide on Windows and iPad; other platforms will follow later. No admin action needed.

item.title: MC1559637: Microsoft Teams: Real-time queue metrics in the Queues app on Mobile
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing real-time call queue metrics in the Queues app on Mobile, allowing calling representatives and supervisors to monitor queue activity and performance on the go. This rollout begins in December 2026, requires no admin action, and enhances visibility without changing queue management.

item.title: MC1559633: Microsoft SharePoint: Agent Chat web part to bring Copilot agents into SharePoint pages
item.description: The Agent Chat web part lets SharePoint authors embed Microsoft 365 Copilot agents into pages for easier discovery and interaction. Rolling out from November 2026 to March 2027 worldwide, it requires no admin action. Permissions remain separate, and no compliance impact is expected.

item.title: MC1559628: Choose how your presenter view is laid out in PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams
item.description: PowerPoint Live in Microsoft Teams now lets presenters choose from four presenter view layouts to suit their style, without affecting attendees' view. This feature, available on Windows, Mac, and web, rolls out worldwide from mid to late November 2026 and requires no admin action.

item.title: MC1387526: Microsoft 365 Backup: Full workload backup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange
item.description: Microsoft 365 Backup introduces Full Workload Backup for SharePoint, OneDrive, and Exchange, enabling admins to protect entire workloads with a single policy. Rolling out from July 2026 (preview) to February 2027 (general availability), it automates backup of all artifacts while preserving existing policies and allows exclusions via CSV.

item.title: MC1528011: Microsoft Teams: External presenter support for event group chat
item.description: Microsoft Teams will support external presenters in event group chat starting late March 2027. This allows external presenters to join and coordinate in event chats if "Enable Green room" and external collaboration are enabled. The change introduces cross-tenant chat without storing new customer data.

item.title: RM577416: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Unified Pricing Management - Manage purchase prices and discounts with attribute-based pricing
item.description: Procurement teams can manage supplier pricing with the same flexible, attribute-based model already used for sales, instead of maintaining large numbers of separate trade agreement lines.

item.title: RM579968: Microsoft Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API
item.description: The PPAC Reporting API gives customers scalable, programmatic access to Copilot Studio usage data from our lakehouse, replacing older unsupported methods for pulling consumption data. Daily JSON data by environment, user, agent and feature powers dashboards, FinOps reporting and automated cost controls.

item.title: RM581629: Planner: Sprints and backlogs in unified plans
item.description: Sprints and backlogs in unified plans let users organize and prioritize work in a product backlog, plan time-boxed sprints, and focus on the current sprint. Sprint planning stays separate from buckets, so teams can continue using buckets to organize work.

item.title: MC1449180: Microsoft Purview: Data Loss Prevention and auto-labeling support for non-Microsoft applications
item.description: Microsoft Purview will support Data Loss Prevention and auto-labeling for non-Microsoft apps like Google Workspace, Box, and Salesforce via Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps connectors. Administrators can manage policies directly in Purview starting mid-March 2027, expanding compliance and data protection capabilities.

item.title: MC1556088: Microsoft Teams: End of support for iOS 17 and iPadOS 17
item.description: Microsoft Teams will end support for iOS 17 and iPadOS 17 starting mid-December 2026, requiring iOS/iPadOS 18 or later for new releases. Existing versions will keep working without support. Organizations should notify users, encourage OS upgrades, update policies, and revise support documentation accordingly.

item.description: Businesses can protect their profitability on sales orders created in the back office sale, while still letting sales teams adjust prices to win deals. Any change that would push an item below the allowed margin goes for review, so discounting decisions stay controlled and consistent across channels.

item.title: RM577847: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Unified pricing management - Rental Management - retrieve rental prices through an API
item.description: The rental pricing API runs on the commerce scale unit and supports headless experiences such as rental e-commerce price queries. It calculates prices from your rental pricing rules with better performance, so every channel can get fast, more consistent results.

item.title: RM577848: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management: Unified Pricing Management Manage purchase prices and discounts with attribute-based pricing
item.description: Procurement teams can manage supplier pricing with the same flexible, attribute-based model already used for sales, instead of maintaining large numbers of separate trade agreement lines.

item.title: RM577850: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Unified pricing management - manage procurement charges with attribute-based pricing
item.description: Procurement teams can apply supplier charges, such as freight, handling or surcharges, consistently, without setting them up manually on each purchase order. With this feature, pricing managers can use unified pricing management to define procurement charges based on attributes. Purchase orders then pick up the right charges automatically.

item.title: MC1558114: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps: Unified RBAC support for App Governance to manage NHIs
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Cloud Apps' App Governance will support unified Defender XDR RBAC in public preview starting late November 2026, enabling delegated, least-privilege access for managing Non-Human Identities. Administrators can assign custom roles for viewing, policy, and service management, with rollout completing by mid-January 2027.

item.title: MC1483844: Microsoft Copilot: GPT 6.1 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5.5 beginning to roll out today
item.description: Microsoft Copilot is rolling out GPT-6.1 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5.5 models starting September 30, 2026, across Cowork, Copilot Studio, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Chat. No admin action is required, but enabling Anthropic and OpenAI subprocessors affects model availability. Usage limits and notifications apply.

item.title: MC1558041: Microsoft OneDrive for iPad: Presentation mode for PDFs
item.description: Microsoft OneDrive for iPad will introduce a presentation mode for PDFs, enabling a focused, view-only experience that disables free scrolling to prevent accidental page changes. Rolling out worldwide in December 2026, it is enabled by default with no admin controls required and does not affect file permissions or compliance.

item.title: MC1558038: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Network data security integration with Azure Firewall
item.description: Microsoft Purview integrates Data Loss Prevention with Azure Firewall to protect sensitive network traffic, including text, files, and AI interactions. Rolling out from mid-November 2026 (preview) to late April 2027 (general availability), it enables automatic tenant activation, policy configuration, and enhanced risk management without disrupting existing policies.

item.title: MC1558037: Microsoft Purview | Data Loss Prevention: Protection for local AI agent interactions
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is expanding to protect sensitive data in supported local AI agent interactions, allowing administrators to apply DLP policies to agent prompts, responses, and tool interactions. Public preview starts late January 2027, with general availability by late April 2027. No action is required to enable this feature.

item.title: MC1558033: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Copilot Managed Runtime expands app building at general availability
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Managed Runtime, now generally available, enables IT-governed app building within tenant boundaries across Copilot Cowork, Studio, and Code. Admins manage apps, policies, and credits via the Microsoft 365 admin center. App building expands beyond the Frontier Program with environment routing and governance controls.

item.title: MC1558030: Microsoft OneDrive for Windows and Mac: node_modules folders will be excluded from sync by default
item.description: Starting December 14, 2026, OneDrive for Windows and Mac will exclude new folders named "node_modules" from syncing by default to improve performance. Existing synced folders remain unaffected. Administrators can disable this exclusion via policy if needed. No user prompts will occur, and local folder use continues.

item.title: MC1558032: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent call recap for call queues in the Queues app on mobile
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile's Queues app will add intelligent call recap for recorded and transcribed call queue calls starting early December 2026. Users can view AI-generated notes, key points, and follow-up tasks without replaying calls. No admin action is needed, but recording, transcription, and licenses should be confirmed.

item.title: MC1558024: Microsoft 365 admin center: New multi-tenant management experiences
item.description: Microsoft 365 admin center will introduce multi-tenant management for centralized control of Copilot, agents, costs, and services across tenants. Available from mid-November 2026, it enables unified tenant linking, insights, and configuration management. Organizations must link tenants via Microsoft Entra tenant governance to use these features.

item.title: MC1558023: Microsoft Copilot in PowerPoint for Windows, Mac, and the web: Introducing new sales-focused skills
item.description: Microsoft Copilot in PowerPoint is introducing new sales-focused skills worldwide by late November 2026 to help sales teams prepare and refine presentations, work with sales data, and support sales conversations. No admin action is needed; users with licenses can enable these skills via the Sales plugin.

item.description: After conversation work presence is a system-generated status that's automatically set when a customer service representative is finishing tasks after a customer interaction, such as writing notes, updating records, selecting dispositions, or completing follow-up actions.

item.title: RM577829: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Service Agent in Microsoft 365 - your dedicated service specialist
item.description: • Rapid onboarding to a hybrid workforce:Service Agent in Microsoft 365 can be hired and onboard with your company's knowledge sources, communication guidelines and escalation rules etc. in minutes. Manager can choose the semi or full autonomous mode.

item.title: RM577899: Dynamics 365 Sales: Customer Context
item.description: Sellers and service reps lose time piecing together a customer picture from tabs, records, and reports, and still miss the signals that matter. Account and Contact 360 delivers one AI-powered view of every account and contact, with relationship, engagement, and opportunity insights and recommended next steps. It works wherever people work: in Dynamics 365 Sales and Customer Service, and in Microsoft 365 through the Sales and Service agents and Cowork. Admins tailor insights to their own data and...

item.title: RM580445: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Build interactive reports and dashboards with Pages
item.description: Turn ideas and source material into rich, interactive reports and dashboards with Pages. Start with a prompt and bring together content, visuals, charts, and interactive elements in one shareable Page where you can work with your collaborators and agents. Edit content on the Page directly just like any other Microsoft 365 file.

item.title: RM580449: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Use Copilot to make on canvas edits on Pages
item.description: Bring Copilot into the flow of collaboration on your Page, not just the chat box. Leave comments on your Page to ask Copilot questions or request targeted edits directly, and have people and Copilot work across the Page while seeing their presence and changes

item.title: MC1392563: OneDrive transitions to the cloud.microsoft domain
item.description: OneDrive is transitioning its URLs from contoso-my.sharepoint.com to onedrive.cloud.microsoft, starting September 2026 and completing by September 2027. Both domains will coexist indefinitely, with no changes to file access or APIs. Admins should review custom solutions and update documentation; no immediate action is required.

item.title: RM575279: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: connecting to Genesys.
item.description: Microsoft now supports out-of-the-box integration with Genesys Cloud through the publicly available connectors and APIs exposed by Genesys. Customers can quickly connect Microsoft AI-powered voice and chat experiences to their existing Genesys environment without custom integration work. This streamlined approach reduces deployment complexity and enables organizations to be up and running in as little as 30 minutes, accelerating time-to-value while preserving existing contact center investments.

item.title: RM570869: Work IQ: Dynamic skills
item.description: Enable agents to select and use the most relevant skills dynamically for each request.

item.title: RM575276: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence: usage-based billing for agents and features
item.description: Microsoft Contact Center Intelligence uses consumption-based billing for AI-powered interactions. Usage generated by voice and digital agents is metered and billed based on actual consumption, including AI model processing, tool usage, orchestration, and related AI services. Usage is attributed to your organization and charged through your configured billing enrollment, enabling transparent cost tracking and pay-for-what-you-use pricing. Authorized users can view usage details, monitor consumpti...

item.title: RM580434: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan Accounts with Sales Research Agent
item.description: Account planning gives sellers one place in Dynamics 365 Sales to decide what they want to achieve with an account, how they'll get there, and how they're tracking against it. The plan lives next to the account, reads live from CRM data, and moves through review and approval before it becomes the active plan for the period.

item.title: RM580436: Dynamics 365 Sales: Build business functions for Sales Research Agent
item.description: A business function gives Sales Research Agent the context and instructions it needs for a specific use case, such as account planning, territory planning, pipeline review, or engagement analysis. Business Function Builder creates that configuration from your data, schema metadata, and optional reference content, so you don't author every field by hand.

item.title: RM580437: Dynamics 365 Sales: Create custom blueprints in Sales Research Agent
item.description: Blueprint Builder lets makers define a reusable, AI-driven planning experience in Sales Research Agent - the starter prompt, sections, data sources, narratives, and visualizations - and save it as a custom blueprint that runs across every account, portfolio, and territory.

item.title: RM580438: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan your sales portfolio with Sales Research Agent
item.description: Portfolio planning is an AI-first capability in Sales Research Agent that turns CRM data, lakehouse signals (such as budgets, targets, usage, billing, and adoption), and web context into a continuously updated plan across accounts, segments, and partners.

item.title: RM580440: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan accounts from Microsoft 365 Copilot Cowork with Sales Research Agent
item.description: Sellers can draft, review, and work their Dynamics 365 Sales account plans from Cowork. Sales Research Agent brings the same account-planning experience - objectives, targets, actions, and gaps grounded in CRM data - into the place sellers already work, and changes are saved to the plan in Dynamics 365 Sales.

item.title: RM570671: Work IQ: Granular MCP policies
item.description: Provide granular policies that restrict MCP access to trusted platforms, workloads, and supported operations.

item.title: RM580439: Dynamics 365 Sales: Plan and rebalance territories with Sales Research Agent
item.description: Territory planning in Sales Research Agent helps sales leaders and sales operations decide where to focus coverage. It combines CRM pipeline and activity with signals such as targets, account potential, and capacity to show how each territory is performing and where to rebalance.

item.title: RM580872: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Enable handling of multiple eliminations in investment projects
item.description: When you enable the Enable Handling of Multiple Eliminations in Investment Projects setting, you activate this feature.

item.description: Together, voice biometric authentication and fraud detection deliver business value by reducing fraud and agent operating costs in contact centers (note: these two capabilities can be used independently or together). item.title: RM577896: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Payments-as-a-Service for Dynamics 365
item.description: This feature provides a shared payment service on Microsoft Dataverse that organisations can integrate into Dynamics 365 business workflows. Scenarios include collecting payments for invoices, sales orders, and work orders in supported applications.

item.title: RM580458: Power Apps: Start SharePoint-connected canvas apps with a modern, responsive template (preview)
item.description: During public preview in early-release environments, the updated SharePoint/Microsoft Lists app-from-data experience gives makers responsive record browsing with grid and list views, plus separate screens for creating and editing records. It creates a standalone canvas app, not an embedded SharePoint customized form. Connector and formula delegation limits still apply.

item.title: MC1557766: Microsoft Viva: Introducing Interactive Insights in the A365 Business Analytics app
item.description: Microsoft Viva introduces Interactive Insights in Agent 365 Business Analytics, enabling eligible users to explore AI adoption and usage via natural-language queries without manual reporting. Rolling out from November 2026 to April 2027, it respects existing data permissions and offers AI-powered summaries and visualizations within authorized scopes.

item.title: MC1557764: Microsoft Agent 365 Business Analytics: Introducing Access Management
item.description: Access Management for Agent 365 Business Analytics centralizes role and permission assignments for admins, combining permission sets and data partitions into access policies. It simplifies management, supports existing roles, and syncs delegation access. Rollout begins January 2027. Admins should review current settings and prepare for policy setup.

item.title: MC1557760: Microsoft Teams: Registration capacity for town halls and webinars increases to 20,000
item.description: Starting December 2026, Microsoft Teams town halls and webinars registration capacity increases up to 20,000, scaling with attendee capacity. item.title: MC1556106: Microsoft SharePoint: Enhanced data access governance reports and site access reviews
item.description: Microsoft SharePoint will enhance data access governance reports and site access reviews starting late November 2026, giving admins better control to identify data risks, prioritize sites, direct review requests, and track email delivery. No action is required before rollout, but admins should prepare accordingly.

item.title: MC1556104: Microsoft PowerPoint: Introducing plugins for Microsoft 365 Copilot
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot in PowerPoint will gain plugins to enhance capabilities with specialized skills and connectors, improving presentation workflows. item.title: MC1556098: Microsoft Teams Mobile: Introducing shared call history in the Queues app
item.description: Microsoft Teams mobile Queues app now offers shared call history for authorized representatives, showing missed, answered, outgoing, and voicemail calls. item.description: SharePoint will change how site logo URLs are updated in search metadata, stopping automatic updates of the SiteLogoUrl property on individual items. item.description: Plugins will be added to PowerPoint for Microsoft 365 Copilot on Windows, enhancing presentation capabilities with new skills and connectors. item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 introduces a new MessageContents table in Advanced Hunting for Teams messages, enabling authorized security analysts to access Teams message snippets and metadata for improved threat investigations. item.description: Microsoft Viva Insights is expanding Power BI report publishing to leaders, allowing them to publish and distribute reports directly. Rollout begins mid-December 2026, enabling enhanced report sharing and management without analyst involvement.

item.description: Microsoft Teams will enhance channel meetings, allowing scheduling from Teams calendar and Outlook, easier discovery for channel members, and delegate scheduling. item.description: Microsoft Teams introduces Facilitator, an AI feature that detects and resolves knowledge gaps in meetings by providing relevant answers via web search in the chat. item.title: RM502520: Microsoft Teams: New sharing panel in meetings - improved content discovery and ease of sharing
item.description: The sharing panel in today’s meetings is the default place for content discoverability and sharing. New sharing panel UI is crafted with intent of modernising and simplifying default tasks such as window sharing, but also for easier discovery of sharing options and more discoverable file sharing.

item.title: RM569206: Microsoft Teams: Pop out calls into a new browser window
item.description: Microsoft Teams browser app users will be able to pop out calls into a simplified call window that stays available while they navigate away from, hide, or minimize the tab or progressive web app (PWA) hosting the call. This helps users multitask and collaborate more easily during calls.

item.title: RM569363: Microsoft Purview: Permissions audit log improvements

item.description: Users in Gov clouds can now report suspicious messages and external users within Teams. By incorporating end-user reports as an additional security signal, this capability helps organizations identify and respond more quickly to phishing, impersonation, spam, and other messaging threats.

item.title: RM570468: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription choices align with admin policies
item.description: Meeting organizers will only see automatic recording and transcription choices in Meeting Options that are allowed by their organization's existing meeting policies. When both recording and transcription are disabled by policy, the automatic setting is not shown.

item.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

item.title: RM573238: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Archive project cost actuals with long-term retention
item.description: Organizations managing high volumes of project transactions need to retain historical cost data without allowing years of completed transactions to continually increase the volume of active operational data. Add placeholders with hint text to guide marketers through entering campaign-specific values, reducing repetitive setup while keeping audience criteria consistent.

item.title: RM579897: Outlook: Copilot Chat Sheet UX Update for Mobile
item.description: Copilot Chat in Outlook on iOS and Android is getting updated! You'll notice smoother animations, improved strings, and some small changes to the header, such as the new/temporary chat button being moved behind the ... button.

item.title: RM579903: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Send each message only once with deduplication for SMS and custom channels
item.description: Deduplicates recipients by contact point, so each phone number or custom channel address gets the message once per send.

item.title: RM579975: Power Automate: Direct triggers for desktop flows

item.title: RM579187: Outlook: Keep folders expanded when you restart Outlook
item.description: Outlook will remember which folders and shared mailboxes you have expanded or collapsed when you restart the app. You can pick up where you left off without opening the same folder branches again. This makes returning to your usual folders easier. #newoutlookforwindows

item.description: Copilot People Connector now supports importing people data with access controls into Microsoft 365. item.title: RM562016: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation

item.description: Users can now upload videos directly into a Teams event or meeting from OneDrive from the "Manage view" options when an organizer has turned on Manage What Attendees See mode. This ensures a smoother high quality video playback with a more consistent experience for attendees.

item.title: RM565374: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention - Policy Sync & Device Health AI-Powered Investigation

item.title: RM566856: Microsoft Teams: Additional health signals available for Teams Rooms on Android on Pro Management Portal
item.description: Expanded Pro Management Portal (PMP) health monitoring for Teams Rooms on Android by surfacing device health signals including storage health, Teams meeting app, calendar sync, secondary display health and network. item.title: RM568067: Microsoft Teams: See more messages on mobile

item.title: RM571879: Microsoft Teams: Granular Conditional Access for Teams meetings

item.title: RM571309: Microsoft Purview: Information Protection-Auto-labeling scale increase for SharePoint and OneDrive

item.title: RM571692: Microsoft Edge: v.157 - Updated performance information in tab hover cards

item.title: RM573274: Planner: Refreshed experience and new capabilities
item.description: Microsoft Planner will be updated with a cleaner, more modern interface, improved navigation, responsive layouts, and a more consistent experience across Planner in Teams and Planner for the web.

item.title: RM573294: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Enable semantic model in Sales agent
item.description: Semantic model helps Sales Agent understand the structure and meaning of an organization’s CRM data. item.title: RM573446: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat in OneNote can create, edit, and refine content
item.description: Copilot in OneNote can generate new content and directly edit when in edit mode. Copilot can bring content from across WorkIQ as well as complete actions across other workflows such as creating Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files.

item.title: RM575288: Microsoft Teams: Phishing Detection in Teams Messaging
item.description: Microsoft Teams is introducing AI-powered phishing detection that uses conversation context to identify phishing and social engineering in higher-risk messaging scenarios, primarily external first-contact chats. Additional protection may apply in certain regions or scenarios. The capability is used only for security protection, and users may see warnings when suspicious activity is detected.

item.title: RM575294: Power Apps: New view layout in model-driven apps
item.description: Makers can now choose to display their data as a calendar or a stack of cards instead of the default grid layout. Makers can configure these layouts directly in the model driven app designer, giving users more intuitive ways to visualize and work with their data.

item.title: RM576194: Microsoft Teams: Loop meeting notes stored in the meeting organizer's OneDrive

This update provides more consistent ownership and management of meeting content while preserving the existing note-taking and collaboration experience for meeting participants.

item.title: RM576882: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Optimize Project Operations - Enable project resources on general journal entries
item.description: This feature expands the existing general journal functionality for modern projects.

item.title: RM577187: Microsoft Purview: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention-View-only access to device onboarding with the View-Only Device Management role
item.description: Microsoft Purview Data Loss Prevention is introducing more granular, role-based access to the Devices page under Settings → Device Onboarding. Previously, viewing or managing device onboarding required broad administrative roles (such as Compliance Administrator, Global Administrator, or Security Administrator). With this update, organizations can grant access using least-privilege Purview role-based access control (RBAC) roles scoped specifically to device operations.

item.title: RM577398: Microsoft 365 Apps: Cloud Update - Export Improvements
item.description: New export improvements are coming to Cloud Update, making it easier for organizations to access and analyze device data. These enhancements will expand export capabilities across Inventory and Cloud Update device views, include additional device and update information, and allow admins to export filtered results so they can focus on the devices most relevant to their needs.

item.title: MC1488841: Microsoft Outlook: Update to default blocked file types in OwaMailboxPolicy
item.description: Microsoft is updating Outlook on the web and new Outlook for Windows to block .msix and .msixbundle file types by default in OwaMailboxPolicy starting December 2026 to enhance security. Organizations using these file types should allow them in policies before rollout; no action needed otherwise.

item.title: MC1530611: Office in Copilot brings the full power of Office into the Microsoft Copilot app
item.description: Office in Copilot now integrates full Word, Excel, and PowerPoint capabilities within the Microsoft Copilot app, enabling creation, editing, and collaboration without leaving the app. Rollout completes by mid-November 2026. No admin action is required, but admins should inform users and review policies. Data access and AI capabilities are expanded.

item.title: MC1381121: Microsoft Purview | Endpoint Data Loss Prevention: Policy sync and device health AI skill
item.description: Microsoft Purview Endpoint Data Loss Prevention introduces AI-powered Policy Sync and Device Health skills for real-time visibility into policy deployment and sync issues. Rolling out mid-2027, it helps admins identify impacted devices, root causes, and remediation actions, requiring Security Copilot enabled in the tenant.

item.title: MC1465768: Microsoft Teams: Users can temporarily pause all notifications
item.description: Microsoft Teams will allow users to temporarily pause notifications for a chosen duration to reduce interruptions and improve focus. This feature, available on desktop, web, and mobile, rolls out globally from mid-September to November 2026. No admin action is needed; users can enable it via their profile menu.

item.title: MC1526651: Microsoft Teams: Malicious QR code detection in messages
item.description: Microsoft Teams will detect malicious QR codes in messages starting mid-November 2026, warning users of harmful links. Detection applies to chats and channels, with external QR codes blurred by default. The feature is enabled via existing Malicious URL protection, requiring no admin action.

item.title: MC1537353: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
item.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding the "Invite to register" feature for events, allowing organizers to email registration links. Rolling out worldwide by late November 2026. No special preparation needed, but configuring a custom domain for M365 notifications is recommended to avoid restrictions. No compliance issues identified.

item.title: MC1508234: Microsoft Teams: Automatic recording and transcription options align with admin policies
item.description: Microsoft Teams will update meeting options to show automatic recording and transcription settings based on assigned policies, adding a new "Record only" option. Rollout starts mid-November 2026, completing by mid-December. No admin action is needed; organizers see only options allowed by their policies.

item.title: MC1546438: Action may be required: Claude models in Copilot are coming into the EU Data Boundary and will be enabled by default
item.description: Starting December 9, 2026, Claude models in Microsoft Copilot will be enabled by default for eligible EU and EFTA tenants, with data processing moved into the EU Data Boundary. Admins can opt out or limit access before that date via the Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1546447: Microsoft Defender for Office 365: Updated recipient inclusion logic for threat protection policies
item.description: Microsoft Defender for Office 365 will change recipient inclusion logic in threat protection policies from Match all (AND) to Match any (OR) when multiple recipient types are specified. This update, rolling out in December 2026, expands policy scope upon modification but does not auto-convert existing policies.

item.title: MC1546429: Power BI retiring standalone Copilot experiences (preview)
item.description: Power BI will retire the standalone Copilot preview in January 2027, replacing it with Microsoft 365 Copilot enabled by default from December 8, 2026. Standalone Copilot access and settings will be removed; organizations should prepare for this transition and notify users accordingly.

item.title: MC1546411: Retirement of Viva Insights (personal insights) and Viva Learning usage reports
item.description: Viva Insights personal insights and Viva Learning usage reports will be retired from the Microsoft 365 admin center by mid-November 2026. Viva Learning analytics remain accessible within the Viva Learning app. Admins should update documentation and inform reporting administrators of this change.

item.title: MC1546409: Microsoft Teams: Retirement of off-network invitations to Teams Free
item.description: Microsoft Teams will retire off-network invitations for Teams Free accounts starting December 2026. Users can no longer invite external people via email or chat links to create Teams Free accounts. Existing Teams Free collaboration and federation remain unchanged. No admin action is needed, but user guidance should be updated.

item.title: MC1506730: Classic Outlook for Windows: Upcoming visual improvements and a more consistent Outlook experience
item.description: Classic Outlook for Windows will receive visual updates—icons, spacing, and alignment—for improved clarity and consistency starting mid-November 2026. A nonintrusive "What’s New" dialog will inform users monthly. No admin action is needed; these changes do not alter workflows or replace the classic experience.

item.title: MC1330893: Pay-as-you-go consumption-based meter for your extra SharePoint storage needs
item.description: Microsoft is introducing a pay-as-you-go billing model for SharePoint storage overages, allowing admins to pay only for extra storage used beyond the included quota. This opt-in feature, rolling out globally in January 2027, integrates with Microsoft 365 Archive and requires Azure billing permissions.

item.title: MC1473155: Microsoft Purview: permissions audit log improvements
item.description: Microsoft Purview is enhancing audit logging for role-based access control, adding two new audit operations to improve transparency and troubleshooting. The update, rolling out worldwide from late September to mid-November 2026, requires no action but helps administrators better investigate access issues and monitor compliance.

item.title: MC1478975: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Use Microsoft Agent 365 agents as connected agents in declarative agents
item.description: Microsoft 365 now supports Microsoft Agent 365 agents using the Agent2Agent protocol as connected agents in declarative agents, expanding integration options. Administrators manage and approve these agents via the Microsoft 365 admin center. Rollout began in August 2026 and completes by December 2026, enabling enhanced AI interactions and workflows.

item.title: MC1509799: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Legal plugins in Word and Cowork
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot introduces legal plugins in Word and Cowork to help legal professionals summarize, draft, review, and redline documents using Microsoft 365 context and third-party sources. Rollout occurs from April to December 2026. Admins can enable or disable these plugins; no setup is required.

item.title: MC1530595: Microsoft Copilot Feedback UX update
item.description: Microsoft Copilot is updating the thumbs-down feedback to include selectable categories and optional comments for more actionable input. The rollout begins mid-November 2026 worldwide, affecting organizational, consumer, and education accounts on web, Windows, and macOS. No admin action is needed; data is stored per existing feedback policies.

item.title: MC1146821: Rewrite with Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat coming soon to Edge for Business users
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot Chat’s Writing Assistance will roll out in Edge for Business by late January 2027, enabled by default. Users can access it via right-click on editable text. Admins can control it with the InlineComposeEnabled policy. DLP policies may restrict its functionality on certain content.

item.title: MC1446796: Migrate Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing before EWS deprecation
item.description: Exchange Web Services (EWS) deprecation starts October 1, 2026, affecting cross-tenant Free/Busy, MailTips, and Calendar Sharing. Microsoft 365 Cross-Tenant Access Policy will replace EWS by late November 2026. Organizations must migrate to avoid disruption; migration guides and updates are provided. GCC rollout is paused.

item.title: MC1545696: Microsoft OneDrive and SharePoint: Annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs on the web
item.description: OneDrive and SharePoint on the web will allow users with editing rights to annotate sensitivity-label protected PDFs without removing labels. Annotations and protections are preserved upon saving. This feature rolls out worldwide in late January 2027, requires no admin action, and applies only to OneDrive for Business and SharePoint.

item.title: MC1545695: App Blocks in M365 Copilot
item.description: App Blocks in M365 Copilot enables interactive apps like calculators and dashboards within Copilot Chat conversations, enhancing user experience without leaving the chat. It rolls out worldwide from late October to early November 2026, affecting Microsoft 365 Copilot users, with no action or compliance issues required.

item.title: MC1545694: Microsoft Entra: Updated passkey registration experience in My Sign-ins
item.description: Microsoft Entra updates the passkey registration in My Sign-ins for Microsoft Authenticator users, adding a checkbox, updated link text, and guided steps to start registration. If direct registration fails, users are directed to WebAuthn flow. Rollout is mid-November 2026 to end-November 2027. Inform users accordingly.

item.title: MC1545691: Microsoft Purview: Retirement of select DSPM partner integrations
item.description: Microsoft Purview will retire select DSPM partner integrations (Varonis, BigID, Cyera, OneTrust) for non-Microsoft data sources on December 7, 2026. These integrations will no longer ingest or display data, but other DSPM capabilities remain unaffected. No action is required, but review dependencies if using these integrations.

item.title: MC1480869: Microsoft 365 settings enabled by default for newly created Engage communities
item.description: Newly created Microsoft Viva Engage communities will have Microsoft 365 group settings enabled by default, subscribing members to community emails and calendar invites. Rollout completes by November 2026. Community owners can adjust settings via the My Account portal. No admin action is required. Existing communities update later this fall.

item.title: RM410396: Microsoft Viva: Import HRIS data in Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center
item.description: Customers will be able to use various connectors to HRIS tools to import HRIS data into Viva Glint from Microsoft Admin Center.

item.title: RM422323: OneNote: Summary and Q&A in OneNote Mobile with Copilot (Android)
item.description: With this new Summary feature in OneNote mobile, you can create a short and fluent summary of your longer pages which will help to consume relevant information faster. item.description: Users can select from multiple voice style options for their voice experience in M365 Copilot.

item.title: RM567671: Planner: Planner Agent chat in Basic Plans
item.description: Introducing built-in Planner Agent chat with natural language Q&A, smart task discovery, and in-plan task management.

item.title: RM567886: Planner: AI-generated Status Reports in Planner Agent
item.description: AI-powered Status Report in Planner Agent turns your plan data into a polished, stakeholder-ready update in minutes. Just ask Planner Agent for a status report and it pulls your task data and transforms it into a clear narrative covering overall status, progress, risks, and what's next. item.title: RM573450: Microsoft Teams: Facilitator's enhanced protection skill can alert you to potential scams
item.description: Facilitator can help you spot suspected attempts by people outside your organization to trick you into sharing sensitive information during a meeting. If it detects a suspected attempt, you'll see a warning in the meeting, with options to end or to temporarily restrict information sharing.

item.title: RM553591: Microsoft Teams: Building level insights on the Pro Management portal recommended actions page
item.description: IT gets new building level insights on the recommended actions page in the Teams Rooms Pro Management portal. This feature intelligently identifies buildings with high Teams Rooms utilization to help IT prioritize upgrades of bring your own device (BYOD) meeting spaces and ensure consistent, high-quality user experiences throughout their office buildings. Available with a Teams Rooms Pro or Shared Space license.

item.title: RM558286: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent meeting recap available without saving transcript
item.description: Intelligent recap can now be generated without retaining a transcript after the meeting. Meeting organizers can choose this setting from the meeting options before the meeting, or organizers and eligible participants can enable it during the meeting. After the meeting, the AI Summary will be available, but other elements of the recap may not be available (Chapters, Topics, Mentions, Audio recap).

item.title: RM561026: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Generate documents using forms in SharePoint with Power Automate
item.description: We are introducing a new Power Automate action that enables automated document generation using document generation (DocGen) forms in SharePoint.

item.title: RM561204: Planner: My Tasks redesign
item.description: A redesigned My Tasks experience that brings your tasks into one place, making it easier to capture work, prioritize what matters, and stay focused.

item.title: RM562535: Microsoft Teams: Assign Open Shifts
item.description: Auto Assign Open Shifts is a Microsoft Teams Shifts feature that automatically fills unassigned (open) shifts for you. It lets managers automatically assign open shifts to available employees instead of doing it manually. The system considers factors like employee availability, approved time off, past scheduling patterns, and scheduling rules (e.g., max hours, rest time); and generates a draft schedule that you can review and adjust before publishing.

item.title: RM565425: Microsoft Teams: Language selection by users in Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: Users can now choose their preferred meeting language in Teams Rooms on Android. Select from up to 69 languages using the language button on the console. The room system must restart after a language is selected.

item.title: RM567306: Microsoft Teams: Enhanced delegated calling with delegate call access restrictions and join notifications
item.description: Call delegation in Teams now includes new controls that give delegators greater privacy and control during active calls. Delegators can lock an ongoing call to prevent delegates from joining or resuming the call and can optionally enable warning tones that notify participants when a delegate joins or resumes a call.

item.title: RM567466: Microsoft Teams: Teams events attendance and engagement report policy
item.description: Teams events will soon have a separate attendance and engagement report policy from the "CsTeamsMeetingPolicy" attendance and engagement report policy. This will permit admins to allow Teams events organizers to access attendance and engagement reports, while restricting access to Teams meeting attendance and engagement reports.

item.title: RM568781: Microsoft Teams: Proximity join support for attendees in Teams events from Teams Rooms on Windows and Android
item.description: Attendees can take advantage of proximity join with Teams Rooms on Windows and/or Android for fast, effortless connection to nearby room systems during Teams events, such as town halls, webinars, and structured meetings.

item.title: RM569207: Microsoft Teams: Report a Security Concern in Meetings
item.description: Microsoft Teams will enable meeting organizers and attendees to report suspicious, malicious, or potentially fraudulent activity directly from meetings. Users can submit reports during or after a meeting, helping organizations identify potential threats such as impersonation, phishing, scams, and other suspicious behavior. Reports are integrated with Microsoft security and administrative workflows to support investigation, remediation, and ongoing improvements to security protections.

item.title: RM569426: Planner: Private tasks now stored in your private plan
item.description: Private tasks created in Planner and Planner-powered experiences are stored in the user’s private plan, providing a single place for tasks visible only to that user. Private tasks cannot be shared or assigned to others, and existing tasks continue to work and appear alongside them.

item.title: RM569447: Microsoft Teams: Breakout room support on Teams Rooms on Android
item.description: With breakout room support, Teams Rooms on Android can be added to a breakout room and moved in and out of the main room making it easy for breakout session coordination.

item.title: RM571299: Microsoft Teams: Ask Copilot from Search on Mobile
item.description: Get answers without leaving search. As you type in the Teams search bar, you'll see an option to ask Copilot alongside search results. You can also select Ask Copilot from the search results page to turn your query into a Copilot conversation, helping you quickly find information, get answers, and ask follow-up questions in context.

item.title: RM573250: Microsoft Teams: Invite attendees to register
item.description: For an event that needs registration, send email invites to the selected people and groups who will be invited to register to the event

item.title: RM573602: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Split your expenses
item.description: Split a single expense across multiple allocations so costs are accurately assigned to the appropriate expense user, project, department, customer, or expense category. Expense Agent helps you define the split and ensures the allocations add up to the original expense amount. Each allocation is recorded separately for reporting and accounting while remaining linked to the original expense.

item.title: RM573603: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Log the expense in a case of lost receipt
item.description: Expense Agent helps employees keep expense submissions moving when an original receipt is unavailable. It guides employees through providing the information needed to support the expense, generates supporting documentation from those details, and enables them to continue the reimbursement process without manually creating replacement documentation.

item.title: RM573604: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Create expense with no attachment
item.description: Save time when recording lower-value expenses by creating them in Expense Agent without an attachment when the amount is below the limit you set on the Expense Agent Setup page. This gives you the flexibility to record qualifying expenses even when a receipt or supporting document isn’t available.

item.title: RM573605: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Enable approving limits and alternate approvers when primary is not available
item.description: Keep expense approvals moving when primary approvers are unavailable or when requests exceed their approval limits. Organizations can set a maximum approval amount—or unlimited approval authority—for each approver, designate a next approver for requests above that limit, and assign alternate approvers as temporary or scheduled backups. Approval requests can route to an alternate approver during periods of unavailability while following the same approval processes and controls.

item.title: RM573606: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Add tags for expenses as submitter
item.description: Make expenses easier to organize and categorize by adding relevant tags when you create or edit expenses in the web application. Add one or more custom tags to capture business, project, event, or other dimensional context beyond standard expense fields.

item.title: RM573607: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Set expense spend limits in Expense Management
item.description: Take control of employee spending earlier in the expense process with configurable spend limits. Define thresholds that reflect your organization’s expense policies and apply them by time period for individual employees, teams, or the whole company. Expenses that exceed predefined limits can be prevented or flagged, with immediate feedback during expense creation.

item.title: RM573608: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Change companies and environments in the web app
item.description: Manage expenses across multiple Business Central companies and environments more efficiently with the Expense Agent web app. Switch between the companies and environments you’re authorized to access within a single session, without restarting the app or signing in again.

item.title: RM573609: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Adding invited guests from calendar as participants to your expense
item.description: Spend less time manually adding attendees to meal-related business expenses. Expense Agent can match the expense to the relevant Outlook calendar event and add invited guests as expense participants, helping keep participant information aligned with the meeting invitation.

item.title: RM573610: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Expense Agent - Use tags to mark processed emails
item.description: Quickly see which expense-related emails have already been processed by Expense Agent, helping you distinguish processed from unprocessed messages with confidence. Expense Agent adds a **Processed by Expense Agent **tag in Outlook after a relevant email has been successfully processed.

item.title: RM573613: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Cross-environment Master Data Management
item.description: Keep critical business data consistent across environments with cross-environment master data management. Centrally manage and govern master data—including customers, vendors, products, and reference data—and keep it synchronized wherever it is used, reducing duplicate maintenance and simplifying administration.

item.title: RM573614: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Use complex calculation methods for excise duties
item.description: Simplify excise duty calculations with flexible methods that better reflect your organization’s tax scenarios. Configure excise duties using specific, ad valorem, or hybrid calculation methods, including calculations based on different tax bases, thresholds, quantities, percentages, or combinations of these factors.

item.title: RM573615: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Configure and use bonded locations for excise duty calculations
item.description: Reduce manual work and support accurate excise duty handling by applying bonded-location rules to inventory. Designate warehouses or storage locations as bonded so excise duties can be deferred while goods remain in bonded storage and assessed when goods move to non-bonded locations or enter taxable circulation, according to configured tax rules.

item.title: RM573616: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Finance - Multiple VAT numbers for a vendor
item.description: Handle VAT correctly for vendors that operate across multiple European Union countries by recording multiple VAT numbers and applying the appropriate VAT Business Posting Group and General Business Posting Group for each transaction.

item.title: RM573617: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Germany - Export euBP with audit files export
item.description: Create more complete audit export packages with less manual preparation by exporting European Business Profile (euBP) information together with transactional audit data. Organizations using the German localization can include both in a single Audit Files Export process.

item.title: RM573618: Dynamics 365 Business Central: USA - Automate employee payments with ACH bank integration
item.description: Organizations in the United States can simplify employee expense reimbursements by paying approved claims directly to employees’ bank accounts through ACH. When used with the Expense Agent, approved reimbursements can be processed automatically, reducing manual payment handling and helping employees get reimbursed faster and more accurately.

item.description: This feature extends support for the Standard Audit File for Tax (SAF-T) format to Iceland, allowing customers in this counmtry to generate audit files using the established SAF-T framework. Key capabilities include:

item.title: RM573621: Dynamics 365 Business Central: France - Install French localization as an extension to the base app
item.description: The localized version for France is now available as a set of extensions on the W1 base app. This version includes a data upgrade feature to simplify the transition from the previous localization. This release moves the product closer to full delocalization, so ISVs can reach a wider market. Some features move to the base app or become global apps, while others stay specific to the French market.

item.title: RM573623: Dynamics 365 Business Central: Norway - Install Norwegian localization as an extension to the base app
item.description: The localized version for Norway is now available as a set of extensions on the W1 base app. This version includes a data upgrade feature to simplify the transition from the previous localization. This release moves the product closer to full delocalization, so ISVs can reach a wider market. Some features move to the base app or become global apps, while others stay specific to the Norwegian market. In the same time some of local features will ber migrated to global ones, such as non-deductible...

item.title: RM576280: Power Apps: Form fill assistance using Microsoft 365 files in model-driven apps
item.description: We’re expanding form fill assistance in Power Apps to use Microsoft 365 files as a source, helping users turn existing content into form entries with less manual effort.

item.title: RM577407: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Inventory validation and fulfillment options on the Store Commerce transaction grid
item.description: When store and trade-counter associates add items to a sale, they need to know right away whether the item can be fulfilled, and if not, what the options are. This feature brings real-time inventory validation and fulfillment options directly into the Store Commerce transaction grid, so associates don't need to leave the transaction to check stock.

item.title: RM577408: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Inventory view modernization on the Store Commerce app
item.description: Store Commerce inventory screens are being modernized with a new, responsive experience built on Fluent UI and React. The modern inventory views give store associates a consistent look and feel and fewer clicks across everyday inventory tasks, and they extend the modern inventory lookup experience to all inventory operations in the store.

item.title: RM577409: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Extend the phone Cart with custom app-bar commands
item.description: Add phone Cart commands and configurable sales-line details so Store Commerce extensions work consistently across device sizes.

item.title: RM577411: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Assign functionality profiles to self-checkout registers
item.description: This feature lets organizations assign a functionality profile directly to a self-checkout register in Commerce headquarters. The register-specific profile can control device settings, transaction reason codes, receipt numbering, and fiscal defaults for each kiosk.

item.title: RM577414: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Guide shoppers through an intuitive self-checkout flow
item.description: Guide shoppers with clearer self-checkout flows, configurable assistance, and register-specific settings across supported Store Commerce devices.

item.title: RM577746: Dynamics 365 Customer Insights - Journeys: Marketing tools, skills and plugin are now available in Copilot Cowork
item.description: The Customer Insights plugin brings Dynamics 365 Customer Insights context, actions, and guided workflows to Copilot Cowork. Marketers and other customer-facing teams can understand customer profiles, author brand-compliant content, and prepare consent-aware outreach using existing segments directly in the flow of work, reducing the need to switch to Dynamics 365 Customer Insights.

item.title: RM577750: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Map keyboard shortcuts to common POS operations
item.description: Applies to: Point of Sale (Store Commerce); configured in Commerce headquarters.

item.title: RM577751: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design and print A4 and thermal receipts in a modern designer
item.description: Applies to: Point of Sale (Store Commerce app, Store Commerce for web), headquarters (Commerce headquarters receipt format designer), Hardware Station, Commerce Scale Unit.

item.title: RM577752: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Apply bulk actions to multiple transaction lines
item.description: Store associates can select multiple eligible transaction lines and apply common updates in one action, including voiding items, changing the delivery mode, and changing the fulfillment location. This capability reduces repetitive work and errors on large orders while preserving line-level validation and providing clear feedback when an update can't be applied.

item.title: RM577855: Dynamics 365 Project Operations: Support larger invoices in Project Operations
item.description: The dual-write asynchronous integration feature in Project Operations enhances the customer invoicing process by enabling scalable and reliable data synchronization between Dataverse and Dynamics 365 Finance. This feature addresses the limitations of real-time dual-write sync, which is restricted to processing a maximum of 1,000 invoice lines per invoice.

item.title: RM577893: Dynamics 365 Commerce: Design POS screen layouts in a modern browser designer
item.description: Create and preview POS screen layouts in headquarters with a modern web designer that simplifies configuration and reduces design iterations.

item.title: RM578858: Microsoft Teams: Shared call history in the Queues app on Mobile
item.description: Calling reps and Supervisor leads can view shared call history for their call queues in the Queues app on Mobile, helping them track call activity, review call details, and coordinate customer follow-ups while on the go.

item.title: RM578859: Microsoft Teams: Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile
item.description: Agents and supervisors can use Copilot in the Queues app on Mobile to quickly understand and follow up on customer conversations. From shared call history, users can ask questions about a past call and use Copilot to surface relevant information and insights from the conversation, helping them get up to speed and take the next step without having to review the entire call

item.title: MC1537497: Microsoft Teams Rooms: Refreshed Analytics
item.description: Microsoft Teams Rooms Pro Management portal will get a refreshed Analytics & Reports experience with updated design, simplified navigation, and new Room and Desk analytics sections. Rollout starts December 2026, completing by January 2027. No action or compliance concerns for admins.

item.title: MC1537495: Microsoft 365 Copilot: Discover featured AI Skills Navigator playlists in Learning Agent
item.description: Microsoft 365 Copilot's Learning Agent will feature AI Skills Navigator playlists, offering curated learning resources via natural language queries. Rolling out worldwide in mid-November 2026, this enhances skill-building for users where AI Skills Navigator is enabled, with no action required but settings review recommended.

item.title: MC1537494: Attention needed: Your tenant will be auto enabled for the new Microsoft Defender RBAC model
item.description: Microsoft Defender RBAC will be auto-enabled in your tenant starting December 2026, unifying access management for Defender and Sentinel. Existing roles will be imported for review before activation about 30 days after notification. Adjust roles as needed; opt-out is available post-activation. Other Microsoft service permissions remain unchanged.

item.title: MC1537490: Intelligent call delegation is planned to change from Frontier public to public preview (Ring 3.6) as early as Nov 17th
item.description: Intelligent call delegation moves from Frontier to public preview (Ring 3.6) starting Nov 17, 2026, using AI to screen calls and schedule via Microsoft Bookings. Rollout runs Nov-Dec 2026; general availability in Jan 2027. Usage-based billing requires admin spending policy setup in Microsoft 365 admin center.

item.title: MC1488845: Private tasks now stored in your private plan in Planner
item.description: Starting December 2026, private tasks in Microsoft Planner will be stored in users' private Planner plans instead of Microsoft To Do, enabling richer Planner features while maintaining privacy and compliance. Existing tasks remain visible, no admin action is needed, and organizations should update related documentation and governance processes.
